feedback.text: always destined to be measured against anthony asquith 's acclaimed 1952 screen adaptation .
lilo & stitch '' is n't the most edgy piece of disney animation to hit the silver screen
even when there are lulls , the emotions seem authentic , and the picture is so lovely toward the end ... you almost do n't notice the 129-minute running time .
it 's not a motion picture ; it 's an utterly static picture .
attempts to fuse at least three dull plots into one good one
-- putting together familiar themes of family , forgiveness and love in a new way -- lilo & stitch has a number of other assets to commend it to movie audiences both innocent and jaded .
